thesis: The discussion argues that venture capital is undergoing a 'death of the middle' where success now requires either being a large generalist or a small specialist rather than a mid-size generalist. This shift is driven by the fact that the best companies now have 'hostages' (customers) rather than just customers, and the market opportunity has expanded so significantly that returning more gross dollars on a larger fund is preferable to achieving higher multiples on a smaller fund.
